utm.title: UTM Parameters
utm.sourceNotRecommended: This source is not commonly used with this medium
utm.customSourceAllowed: Custom sources allowed for this medium
utm.mediumTip: What channel type brought them here? e.g. paid ads (cpc), organic social (social), email, QR. Pick this first so Source filters accordingly.
utm.sourceTip: Who specifically referred them? e.g. google, facebook, newsletter_weekly. Available sources depend on the Medium you picked.
utm.campaignTip: Which marketing campaign does this link belong to? Use lowercase with underscores, no spaces. Examples: spring_sale_2026, product_launch_q2
utm.contentTip: Distinguishes different creatives or placements within the same campaign — perfect for A/B testing. Examples: banner_top, cta_red, video_30s_version_a
utm.termTip: Mainly for paid search ads to track keywords. Google Ads auto-fills this — usually safe to leave blank.
utm.batchDescription: Enter multiple keywords, one per line, to generate multiple short URLs
utm.description: Save reusable UTM parameter sets to speed up link creation
utm.deleteTemplateConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this template?
utm.templateSelectorHint: Select a saved template to auto-fill UTM parameters
utm.campaignCalloutTitle: Campaign is this link's management anchor
utm.campaignCalloutBody: This value decides which campaign the link rolls up under — drives the Campaigns list, goal tracking and cross-campaign compare. Links left blank only appear in the orphan section.
utm.campaignNewOnSave: New campaign — will be created on save
utm.campaignEmptyHint: Leave blank and the link won't appear in the Campaigns list
utm.comboboxTypeToCreate: Type a campaign name to create one
utm.sourceGovernanceWarning: "{value}" is not on the workspace approved source list ({list}) — will be rejected on save.
utm.mediumGovernanceWarning: "{value}" is not on the workspace approved medium list ({list}) — will be rejected on save.
utm.templatesOnlyChannelPreset: Templates are channel presets — campaign is set per-link when creating.
utm.templateSelectorHintOptional: Fills medium / source / content in one click. Not required — you can pick them below.
utm.templatesIntroBody: A saved set of medium / source / content for a channel you use over and over — e.g. 'Weekly EDM' = email / newsletter_weekly, or 'Booth QR' = qr / poster. It only saves typing and keeps everyone's spelling the same.
utm.templatesIntroOptional: You don't need it. When creating a link you can choose medium and source directly in the UTM section.
utm.templatesIntroHowTo: To use one: click 'Use' on a template here, or pick it at the top of the UTM section when creating a link. Templates never include the campaign — you fill that in per link.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Track clicks, visitors, and campaign performance
analytics.referrersHint: From the HTTP Referer header — only set when the click came from a web page. Email / Slack / WhatsApp / direct paste don't carry a referer. For real channel breakdowns use utm_source / utm_medium below.
analytics.includeTestTip: Two kinds of clicks are excluded by default: test clicks ('Test link' button with ?_test=1, or workspace members opening their own links) and suspected mail-security scanner clicks (outdated browsers that auto-open every link in an EDM). Toggle on to see everything.
analytics.filteredTestClicks: {n} test click(s) excluded (from 'Test link' button or workspace members)
analytics.realTrafficOnly: Real traffic only (test and suspected bot clicks hidden)
analytics.includingTestClicks: Including test and suspected bot clicks (unfiltered)
analytics.inWindowClicks: {n, plural, one {# click} other {# clicks}} in selected window
analytics.citiesHint: Top 15 cities by clicks (resolved via GeoIP — accuracy varies by region).
analytics.decayHint: Hour-by-hour cumulative + per-hour clicks since this campaign's first click. No data yet.
analytics.decayHintWithPct: {pct}% of total clicks happened within 24 hours of the first click. Curve below shows the full pickup pattern from t0.
analytics.decayNeedsFilterTitle: Pick a campaign or link to see decay
analytics.decayNeedsFilterHint: This curve only makes sense when scoped to one launch — otherwise we'd be averaging across unrelated activities at different times.
analytics.heatmapHint: Heatmap of click times across the selected window. Darker cell = more clicks. Use to pick optimal EDM / social post timing.

campaigns.exportTimeseriesHint: Date × campaign, ideal for pivot tables / charts

detail.deleteDialogBody: This campaign has {count} link(s). Choose what to do with them:
detail.deleteAlsoPauseLabel: Also pause all links in this campaign
detail.deleteAlsoPauseHelp: Short URLs will redirect to the "link inactive" page instead of the original destination. Use this when retiring a whole project. You can re-activate any link later.
detail.deleteSuccess: Campaign deleted. Links unlinked but still functional.
detail.exportLinksHint: One row per link: clicks, unique visitors, last click
detail.exportDailyHint: Date × link (for the selected period), ideal for pivot tables / charts
detail.resetDialogBody: This flags all {count} real click(s) across {links} link(s) in this campaign as test data. KPIs / charts will drop to 0 immediately.
detail.resetReversibleNote: Reversible — data is preserved, not deleted
detail.resetDataPreservedNote: Toggle 'Include test clicks' in Analytics to see them
detail.resetKpiDropNote: KPIs and trend charts will show 0
detail.setGoalHint: Set a click goal to track progress toward your target
detail.noClicks30d: No clicks recorded in the last 30 days
detail.noTraffic30d: No traffic data for this campaign in the last 30 days.
detail.topSourcesHint: where the traffic is coming from
detail.noLinksInCampaign: No links found for this campaign
detail.colShareTooltip: Share of this campaign's total clicks
detail.periodHelp: Once set, the campaign list, the numbers on this page and goal progress count only clicks inside this period (Taiwan time, both days inclusive). Status follows the dates: Upcoming / Active / Ended. Either date can be left empty.
detail.archiveTooltip: Archive: hide from the campaign list; links keep working
detail.archivedBanner: This campaign is archived: it's hidden from the campaign list (filter by Archived to see it). Short links still redirect and record clicks.
detail.deleteSuggestArchive: Just want it off the list? Archive it — no data or links change.
detail.drillHint: Click any item below (source, medium, content, link, country, referrer site) to filter — every number on this tab follows.
detail.drillNoClicks: No clicks match these filters in this period
detail.topContentsHint: Which email, post or poster within a channel
detail.referrerSitesHint: Grouped by site; most email and QR clicks carry no referrer
detail.linksExpandHint: click a row to expand that link
detail.colLifetimeTooltip: Daily clicks from the campaign's first click to today, on one shared axis for all rows; right: the busiest day
detail.linkNoClicksYet: This link has no clicks yet.
detail.filterTrafficByLink: Show only this link in Traffic
detail.goalChannelHint: Set a goal per utm_medium; the total is their sum. Leave a channel empty for no goal.
detail.goalNoChannels: None of this campaign's links have a utm_medium, so only a total goal is possible
detail.goalPaceLegend: Grey line = where an even pace over the campaign period would be today
detail.goalPaceHint: Set the campaign's start and end dates to get a pace line (where you should be today).
detail.goalUnassigned: Channels without a goal (still counted in the total): {list}

campaigns.goalBasisTooltip: Goal progress always counts the campaign period (all time if none is set), regardless of the window selected above
campaigns.goalPaceTooltip: Even pace would be {pct}% today (grey line)

compare.notFound: None of the requested campaigns were found. They may have been deleted.
compare.alignStartTooltip: Day 0 = each campaign's start date (or its first click when no period is set), so campaigns held at different times line up
compare.alignNoData: Alignment needs at least two campaigns with a start date or clicks
compare.alignStartOutside: Some campaigns start outside the selected window, so their curve is cut off when aligned — switch to Campaign period or All time.

kickstart.title: Campaign Kickstart

q.type: What kind of campaign is this?
q.typeSub: Pick a type and we'll lay out the usual channels and name every UTM for you.
q.basics: What's it called, and when does it run?
q.basicsSub: These set the tracking name, status and goal pace. You can change them later on the campaign page.
q.destinationSubExhibition: The show's landing page. Booth QR codes can each point somewhere else (e.g. demo booking) in the next step.
q.destinationSubLaunch: The product or campaign page. Every link goes here by default; you can change individual links later.
q.channelsSub: Laid out along the timeline — tick what you'll use. Posting several pieces on one channel? Use "Add another". Each piece gets its own tracked link so you can tell them apart.
q.goalsSub: Each channel gets its own progress bar on the campaign page, with a pace line. Not sure? Use the suggested values, or skip.
q.reviewSub: These are the links that will be created. Edit titles, content, codes and URLs inline; codes are checked as you type.

type.exhibitionDesc: Pre-show promotion → on-site QR → post-show follow-up
type.launchDesc: Announcement post, email and press release, plus a follow-up wave
type.ecommerceSoon: Coming soon (Amazon Black Friday / Prime Day)

kickstart.modeExisting: Add links to an existing campaign
kickstart.campaignHint: Generated from the name; every link shares it. Use the same value in GA4 and ad platforms so the numbers line up.
kickstart.nameTaken: A campaign with this tracking name already exists.
kickstart.existingHint: Keeps its tracking name; channels it already has are skipped automatically.
kickstart.periodHintExhibition: Suggested: from the first teaser email to two weeks after the thank-you email.
kickstart.periodHintLaunch: Suggested: launch day to six weeks after.
kickstart.startInPast: The start date is in the past — is the year right?
kickstart.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
kickstart.ownerHint: Whose KPI this campaign counts toward.
kickstart.pagePending: The campaign page isn't live yet
kickstart.pagePendingHint: Use the homepage for now. These links get a "page pending" tag so you can filter and update them in one go once the page is live — short links stay the same.

phaseHint.pre: Get the right people to the booth
phaseHint.live: One link per physical spot, so you learn which spot works
phaseHint.post: Follow up within a week of the show

kickstart.goalNoRef: No past data for this channel
kickstart.goalPaceNote: While the campaign runs, the campaign page marks where you should be by today.
kickstart.goalSkipNote: No end date, so there's no pace line — you can add one later on the campaign page.
kickstart.someFailed: {ok} created, {n} failed (fix and press again — created links won't be duplicated):
kickstart.doneSub: Campaign {campaign}'s period, owner and goals are set too.
kickstart.next1: Open each link once with "Test short URL" to check where it lands (test clicks aren't counted).
kickstart.next2: For printed QR codes, download the SVG from the campaign page's Links tab for the designer, then scan a proof with a phone.
kickstart.next3: Once it's running, check each channel's goal progress on the campaign page — channels behind pace show in orange.
kickstart.settingsSaveFailed: Links were created, but the period / owner / goals didn't save — set them on the campaign page.
kickstart.rowsNeedFix: {n} row(s) need fixing (red boxes) before creating.
